create_encoder_from_pretrained: create an Encoder that loads a pretrained HuggingFace model from a given model path with configurable dropout
create_encoder_from_config: create an Encoder from config only without loading pretrained weights by setting initialize to false
run_encoder_forward: run the Encoder forward pass with tokenized input and return transformer outputs as a dictionary
add_adapter_to_encoder: add an adapter module to the Encoder transformer with a given name and adapter config
review_encoder_init: review the Encoder class init to understand how dropout, hidden layers, and vocab size are configured
